summary: Learn to assess IT exposure, prioritize remediation, and build risk records using NIST SP 800-30. Explore the course and strengthen your practice.
lede: IT risk assessment and mitigation helps technology risk analysts, security officers, and managers connect system exposures to service and business consequences. Participants practise mapping assets and service dependencies, rating threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact, distinguishing vulnerability severity from business risk, reviewing control gaps, and recording prioritized treatments, owners, and residual risk in risk registers.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who assess technology exposures, coordinate control responses, or report IT risk to service owners and leadership. It is designed for people who need to turn security findings and operational issues into traceable risk decisions.
modules: NIST CSF 2.0 and IT Risk Context
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with IT services, information security, or technology operations is useful. No coding or programming is required.
